start: Android phone with a connected Wear OS watch that has no MettleUp watch app

must_not: The row missing while a watch is connected

user_sees: 'Opening on your watch…' then 'Check your watch: its Play Store is open on MettleUp. Tap Install there.'
must_not: A success line when the watch's Play Store never opened
A wait longer than about 20 seconds

steps.action: Install on the watch, come back to Settings

start: After the first finished workout, watch connected without the app

user_sees: Card 'MettleUp works on your watch too', 'See your rest timer and next set on your wrist.', buttons 'Install on watch' and 'Not now'
must_not: The card on a phone with no watch
The card back on the next visit

start: Watch has an older MettleUp watch app

user_sees: Pop-up 'Your watch app has an update' with 'Update on watch'
must_not: The pop-up over an open workout
'Updated' before the watch even opened its Play Store

start: No watch connected (watch off or out of reach)

steps.action: Tap 'Install on watch' on a card shown earlier
user_sees: 'Your watch is not connected. Open Play Store on your watch and search MettleUp.'
must_not: A crash or an endless spinner

steps.action: Tap 'Install on watch' on an old card
user_sees: 'MettleUp is already on your watch. When you start a workout, it opens on your watch too.'
must_not: The watch's Play Store opened again for nothing
